summary: Frontend-only retest of the iteration_52 fixes, all PASS. (1) Super Admin Preview GC5 after reset: L2 colour_match official reached SUCCESS (00:05.685). L3 memory_match: world-client-stopwatch ticked live from zero (00:00.195 -> 00:01.695 over 1.5s, not frozen at the previous game's time). Solved 6 pairs: SUCCESS with preview-result-time 00:11.514, matching the simulated leaderboard 'You (Admin) · 11.51s'. (2) preview-game-select shows 'Colour Match (Free World)' (value colour_match) for L2 and Champion; L3 shows 'Memory Match (pairs)'. (3) Demo 'Skip practice' (world-client-game-skip) goes to preview-ready with label 'OFFICIAL ATTEMPT'; preview-demo-result does not render. Verified on desktop and mobile. (4) The Board3D title is inside the dark board: 'Sequence Grid' rgb(96,165,250) on a navy gradient in the real Free World demo (player1, free-world-level-33, GC4 L3); 'CHROMA CLASH' amber on a dark gradient in the admin preview. Good contrast. (5) Mobile 390px: support-assistant-launcher and global-back-button are visible on the world map, hidden in the .fwv3-overlay entry and demo, and visible again after Close. In the admin full-gameplay-preview, global-back-button is hidden while open and visible after Exit (the launcher is not rendered on admin pages). (6) Regression: lb-tab-level/lb-tab-championship switch correctly (aria-selected). The level tab shows GC4 L9 Colour Match with GameZoo Admin 00:17.123. The Free World number-sequence demo 1-20 completes to 'Ready to play?'. No official attempts were consumed and no GC4/GC5 configs were changed.

critical_code_review_comments: PreviewPlaySurface now derives startedMs/finishedMs/passed from memory for memory_match, which is correct. resultMs uses `finishedMs || 0`, so a genuine 0 is fine; there are no remaining stale-play paths.
FreeWorldNumberSequenceV3.jsx is still around 2800 lines; split it into modules.
